LoginPage.title: Get started
LoginPage.description: Log in or create an account to apply for the Wezesha Majuu loan.
LoginPage.roleStepDescription: Choose your role first. Next you will log in with eCitizen, email, or phone.
LoginPage.individualRoleSubtitle: I am a listed group member
LoginPage.individualRoleDescription: Complete your personal application after the group chair has listed you.
LoginPage.groupRoleDescription: Start or continue the group application for your members.
LoginPage.loginStepDescription: Use eCitizen, email, or phone. Your application is saved at each step.
LoginPage.flowDescription: The application will be <bold>saved at each step</bold> and you can return to complete it by <bold>logging in.</bold>
LoginPage.submittedDescription: Once submitted, you can track the application progress <bold>through your account.</bold>
LoginPage.invalidPhoneFormat: Please enter a valid phone number (9 digits)
LoginPage.memberCtaDescription: Open your personal application after login. Use the same phone number or national ID as on your member record.
LoginPage.groupCtaDescription: Log in below to continue group applications started with this phone number, email, or national ID.
LoginPage.groupCtaContinueDescription: Log in below to continue your group application. You can also open an individual application if you are a listed member.

MyApplicationPage.title: My individual application
MyApplicationPage.notFoundDescription: We could not match your account to a member record yet. Enter your national ID to find your application, or start a new group application.
MyApplicationPage.chooseDescription: Your account is linked to more than one individual application. Open the one you want to continue.

SignUpPage.title: Create an Account
SignUpPage.description: Fill in the details below to create your account.

FrontPage.title: Wezesha <title>Majuu</title><lineBreak/><subTitle>Labour Mobility Loan Programme</subTitle>
FrontPage.description: Apply for group and individual loans to support <underline>labour mobility</underline> for registered youth groups.

criteria.title: Eligibility Criteria
criteria.one: Groups of three individuals registered with Micro Small and Medium Enterprise Authority (MSEA).
criteria.two: Groups must hold a valid registration certificate and a bank account in the group name.
criteria.three: Groups should include youth, women, and persons with disabilities.
criteria.four: The group chair completes the group application first.
criteria.five: Each listed member completes an individual application after group submission.
criteria.six: Incomplete individual applications may delay group processing.

ApplyPage.title: Start Application
ApplyPage.groupDescription: Group chair or authorized representative completes the group loan application.
ApplyPage.individualDescription: Members complete individual details after the group application is submitted.

DashboardPage.groupQuickAccessDescription: Continue or view group applications linked to this phone number, email, or national ID.
DashboardPage.individualApplicationsHint: Open your personal Wezesha Majuu application, including signed documents.
DashboardPage.individualQuickAccessDescription: View documents, download your tripartite agreement, and complete pre-disbursement consent.

emptyState.title: No applications yet
emptyState.description: Start a group application, or log in with the phone or national ID used on your member record to open your individual application.

status.groupSubmitted: Group application submitted — members can complete individual applications
